_meta.categoryNote: DhanBoost is a NON-BANKING entity. The DLT 'Transactional' category is reserved for banks (card / net-banking OTP). Every template below — including the login OTP — MUST be registered as 'Service Implicit'.
_meta.urlNote: The URL https://www.dhanboost.com/login MUST be (a) a live registered domain and (b) whitelisted under the entity on the SmartPing/DLT portal (URL/APK whitelisting) BEFORE these templates are submitted, or templates containing the link are rejected. As of 2026-07-31 dhanboost.com is NOT yet registered — that is the first blocker. OTP is intentionally link-free (links in OTP messages are discouraged and often rejected).

rules: One variable = up to 40 characters. Provide a sample value per variable.
Brand name 'DhanBoost' is mandatory inside the content body.
No extra / double / trailing spaces anywhere.
The sent SMS must match the registered template character-for-character (only {#var#} slots substituted).
For SMS render amounts as 'Rs.' not '₹' — '₹' forces UCS-2 (Unicode) SMS: 70 chars/segment and higher cost.
Any URL in a template must be pre-whitelisted on the DLT portal or the template is rejected.
